_discovery.describe: Complete end-to-end pipeline for creating 3D game assets with human validation checkpoints. Orchestrates three-stage workflow: (1) AI image generation from text prompts using Stable Diffusion, (2) SVG vectorization for clean edges, (3) 3D mesh extrusion with configurable depth and beveling. Each stage includes human validation before proceeding to next. Supports multiple AI models (Mistral default) for prompt engineering. Processing time: ~60-90 seconds for full pipeline (20s PNG + 15s SVG + 30s 3D). Best for creating game icons, logo assets, UI elements that need depth. Requires GPU for image generation.
use_cases: Create 3D game icons from text descriptions
Generate extruded logos and UI elements
Rapid prototyping of 3D assets with validation
Educational pipeline for understanding AI asset creation
